label: Norwegian occupational pension (OTP)
name: Name
salaryHelp: Enter regular pay from the employer covered by this account. Leave at zero for a paid-up account.
additionalHelp: Enter the rate in your employer’s agreement for pay between 7.1 and 12 times the National Insurance base amount (G).
startHelp: Forecast payments start at month-end from age 62. Automatic start is modeled at 75.
shortenSmallBalance: Shorten the term for a small balance
shortenHelp: For a low balance, estimate a whole-year term that aims for an annual payment of about 20% of G.
termNote: The standard forecast pays for at least 10 years and through age 77.
shortTermSummary: Term depends on capital at withdrawal
invalidOwner: Select a person with a known year and month of birth.
invalidException: Choose whether to shorten the term for a small balance.
invalidStart: Enter a valid age, date, retirement or milestone.
